title: Telecommunications and Media Industries, B.A. (Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications)
notes: Built from the archived 2023-24 bulletin (raw HTML fetched directly, cross-checked against printed subtotals: 15/16/16-17/15/15/15/14.5/13.5, Total Credits 120-121). Confirmed the printed Suggested Academic Plan table itself is IDENTICAL in structure to TELE-2022.json's -- same semester positions for COMM 160/180/280/380, the ECON 102/ECON 14/SCM 200/STAT 200 choice, Foreign Language, and the old pre-reform Gen Ed domain layout (Quantification 6cr, Writing/Speaking 9cr, Arts/Health/Humanities/Social/Natural Knowledge Domains, Inter-Domain 6cr). This page does carry a 'Spring 2024 Curricular Update' banner, but it only applies to the prose 'Requirements for the Major' credit-summary boilerplate and General Education domain-credit description (which already shows the *post*-reform 3-credit-per-domain numbers effective Spring 2024, ahead of the plan table) -- the actual semester-by-semester Suggested Academic Plan table on this same page was NOT updated and still prints the old domain layout, so this file (like TELE-2022.json) follows the real plan table rather than the transitional prose. Real, confirmed course-list differences from TELE-2022.json's own pools (not carried over from 2022, extracted fresh from this year's own Requirements-for-the-Major text): Additional-Courses ('select 12') pool dropped COMM 305, 383A, 410, 419, 419H, and 490 versus 2022, leaving COMM 170/190(GAME 140)/282/283/310(IST)/374/383/384/385/386/388/479/482/483/484/484A/491/491A/493/495 (491A is new this year); the law-course list gained a bare 'COMM 403' alongside 403H (COMM 403/403H/404/492); the Social Aspects supporting-course list gained COMM 419H (COMM 110/118/205(WMNST)/304/305/405/409/410/412/413W/417/418/419/419H/496); and the old 'COMM 410 and COMM 419 cannot double-count' footnote was replaced with 'Law courses beyond the required 3 credits can count against the 12 credits of additional courses.' Same inline-list-vs-Requirements-section drift found in TELE-2022.json persists here too (verified directly in the raw HTML): the plan table's own embedded 'select 12' cell text names COMM 242 (not in the Requirements list at all) and drops several courses the Requirements section does list -- treated the Requirements-for-the-Major section as authoritative, same choice as 2022. 'End Campus: University Park' confirmed on this archive's own campus-availability section, same as every other year checked -- no campus field needed. 'etm' marks Entrance-to-Major requirement courses.
